scenario: Interval relation with non-interval operand per LINT.4 — using `contains` with a non-interval right-hand side (a literal number) is a compile error DS_VALIDATE_INTERVAL_REL_NON_INTERVAL.
rules_ds:
schema Window scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    start: Int mutable
    end: Int mutable

rule check:
    Window w where (w.start..w.end) contains 42
->
    log info "ok"
